property_summary: For every non-owner caller, transferOwnership must leave owner unchanged (the onlyOwner gate); the mutant lets any non-owner set owner, so for a fuzzed non-zero actor and non-zero newOwner the mutant's owner differs while the reference reverts and keeps owner at its old value.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can transfer ownership, yielding a different owner value after non-owner calls.
